_comment: Corrections to where a map's custom minimap is placed (PACK.md, The custom minimap as SVG), for maps whose minimap doesn't follow the general rule exactly: map name as the game names it -> cells added to each edge of the rectangle the rule gives (left, bottom, right, top; positive is right or up), and what was seen. Hand-curated, set by looking at the minimap over the map's render.

Volskaya Foundry.note: drawn about 2 cells shorter than the map's scale: with the rule, the bottom lies on the render and the top runs 2 cells past the top building's wall
